object: White houses of Oia on Santorini — stepped Cycladic settlement view
creator: Multiple building makers; individual architects and construction dates not established
work_date: Individual building dates unknown; current settlement photographed in 2017
branch: Cycladic / Oia regional massing and exterior transitions
rights_evidence: Commons file identifies Radek Kucharski and links the original Flickr image with CC BY 2.0. Date is recorded as the photograph date rather than the upload/publication date.
attribution: Radek Kucharski, White houses of Oia on Santorini (Flickr 52181448879), 1 September 2017, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Provider thumbnail retained unchanged.
claim_scope: A regional Cycladic settlement comparator: adjoining and stacked volumes, small openings, terraces and exterior stair/path transitions. It is not a universal Mediterranean palette or evidence that every pictured building is historically original.
observable_features: Numerous mostly white and some pastel building volumes adjoin and step across the cliff slope rather than form isolated objects on a flat site.
Flat roof terraces, rounded roof/parapet segments, small dark openings and exterior transitions recur across the cluster.
A long exterior stair/path descends alongside the settlement and connects several levels; the sea and landform provide readable setting.
Architecture dominates the view without a foreground restaurant, large flag or retail sign. A small pack-animal/rider group remains near the lower edge and does not obscure the building combinations.
limits: This is a readable settlement overview, not a close construction detail or an unchanged historical reconstruction. Individual architects, building ages, restoration/resort adaptations, hidden wall composition and climate performance remain unverified. A small lower-edge pack-animal/rider group is visible. White and blue alone are not Mediterranean criteria; other regional traditions may use very different materials and colors.

association_evidence.supports: The exact Commons/Flickr record identifies Oia on Santorini, photographer Radek Kucharski, photo date and CC BY 2.0. It does not authenticate every individual building’s age or use.

The Greek National Tourism Organisation identifies the Santorini/Oia regional setting and traditional settlements. The selected image supplies its own visible massing/transition evidence; general destination text does not establish the age of each pictured unit.
